nodes.plm_action: Placing seeds in the soil
nodes.plm_caption:
This video shows a woman sitting in front of three buckets of dirt, with some plant markers in the soil. There's also two bags of seeds on a table in front of the woman, and they are also put into the buckets. Then, some type of small container is also put over one of the buckets and covered with a piece of plastic. All three buckets have sticks with writing on them inserted into the dirt. The video also briefly cuts to the contents inside an airtight clear container with a lid, while the woman sits in front of the buckets. Also at the end of the video, two pictures of seeds in a hand are shown.
The woman explains what the contents in the buckets are and why she's put them on her front table. The contents are put on the table, then cut to the airtight container. And then the final shot of seeds are shown in a hand.
The inside of airtight plastic container with clear lid.
A few pieces of plastic on a table.
Buckets with dirt and plant markers.
A metal square container.
Wooden board on a table.
The video shows how to grow seeds.
There's a couch in the background. Also, a desk and a plant in the background. The background shows a desk with small containers on it. In the front, the woman is wearing a dark blue shirt. The buckets are green and silver. There's a white piece of plastic and a white spray bottle.

summary.brief: A presenter plants herb seeds in three soil buckets, labels them, waters them and covers them with clear plastic under a lamp.
summary.detailed: The video opens with a woman wearing a dark‑blue shirt seated at a table that holds three green‑ and silver‑colored buckets filled with soil. She places two seed bags on the table, explains that the seeds (cilantro, basil, oregano, parsley) come from previous harvests and a school garden, and shows how to start them indoors. Using a skewer and cork markers she writes each herb’s name and inserts the markers into the soil. She sprink­les the seeds onto the surface of each bucket, adds a thin (about a quarter‑inch) layer of soil to cover them, and gently presses the soil down. She then waters the soil with a watering can and immediately covers each bucket with a clear plastic sheet or saran wrap to keep moisture in. The buckets are positioned under a desk lamp with a CFL bulb for germination. The camera pans over additional pots and containers that are similarly labeled and covered, and briefly cuts to the inside of an airtight clear container. The segment ends with a close‑up of two seeds held in a hand, overlaid with the text “Thanks for watching!”.

action.detailed: Sow the herb seeds into each bucket, cover them with a thin layer of soil, water the soil, and seal the buckets with clear plastic to retain moisture.
action.actor: The woman presenter wearing a dark‑blue shirt
